title.it: Copie smarrite, danneggiate o in riparazione

description.it: Le copie da controllare o sostituire.

sql: SELECT i.status AS status, i.barcode AS barcode, b.title AS title, b.author AS author, date(i.updated_at) AS changed FROM item i JOIN biblio b ON b.id = i.biblio_id WHERE i.status IN ('lost', 'damaged', 'in_repair') ORDER BY i.status, b.title
